title: Better Than a Jet? ✈️ TBM 930: The Ultimate Speed Machine
description:
Why choose between efficiency and speed when you can have both? 🚀 In Part 1 of our TBM 930 series, we’re breaking down the "Glass-Cockpit Rocket." We explore how a failed Mooney prototype became the world’s most iconic fast turboprop. From the legendary PT6A engine to the 5-blade Scimitar prop, see why this 330-knot SUV of the skies is the king of the ramp.

📖 Chapters
00:00 - intro
00:37 - intro video
00:59 - From Texas to Tarbes - TBM history
12:23 - TBM 930 - external walkthrough & design
16:17 - TBM 930 - performance: "by the numbers"
17:43 - TBM 930 - conclusion & teaser
18:10 - outro video
